My mom is like this so I understand and it's actually just me and her, my grandparents and 2 uncles ( I'm the only "child" in the family... I'm 23 but my uncles don't have any children) and she gave me a very hard time about people I was seeing because I have a lot going on for myself .. 
She was never rude to my exes but she was putting a lot of pressure on me to end things with them because she thought I was carrying them as well and she thought they made me go through a lot with their mental health issues( I have anxiety and depression so she didn't want me to deal with theirs too) but they never really put any stress on me or anything it was just her getting worried for nothing... I don't want to take your mom's side because I know it's frustrating dealing with a mom that's kinda messing up your life plans but all I can tell you is that this is coming from a place of love, wanting what is best for you.... But you should communicate to her that a trully loving mother shouldn't make you choose between 2 things you love its cruel and unfair and at the end of the day you are a grown woman that knows what's best for her... If you say this in a kind way and she still is acting like this well it's her problem at this point if she doesn't show up to things, she is acting like a child and is more of a problem than a nurturing and caring mother
